xmldoc.short_description: Write the serialized FileDescriptorSet of a schema.

param_input_item.param_description: a protobuf.Schema object returned by protobuf.load.

param_output_item.param_description: a uint8 vector: the serialized FileDescriptorSet, the imports first and then the loaded file, as protoc --descriptor_set_out --include_imports writes it.

description.p: protobuf.descriptor serializes a loaded schema as a FileDescriptorSet. The bytes describe the loaded file and all of its imports, so the schema can be rebuilt later with protobuf.load even when the .proto sources are gone.
The output matches what protoc writes with --descriptor_set_out --include_imports, so it can be read by other Protocol Buffers tools and runtimes.

example_item.example_item_description: Write a descriptor set and load it back
